topic.label: Hedge Funds and Alternative Investments
topic.desc: Alternative investment vehicles: hedge fund strategies and structures (onshore and offshore, master-feeder), private equity and venture capital, prime brokerage and fund operations, and how investors subscribe and track them.

concepts: Long/short equity, global macro, event driven, relative value, credit and quant strategies.
Delaware LPs, Cayman funds, master-feeder structures, side pockets and why each is used.
Buyouts, growth and venture funds, capital calls, J-curve, carried interest and exits.
Prime brokers, fund administrators, NAV calculation, custody, margin and securities lending.
How investors subscribe and redeem: eligibility, subscription documents, lockups, gates, and investor reporting.
skills: Explains a hedge fund strategy's return sources, risks and typical leverage.
Explains a master-feeder structure, which investors use which feeder and why.
Compares onshore, offshore and parallel fund structures for an investor base.
Explains fund terms: management fee, carry, hurdle, waterfall and capital calls.
Maps a fund's service providers (prime broker, administrator, auditor, custodian) and what each does.
Explains how an investor subscribes to a fund: eligibility, documents, KYC, lockups and redemptions.
